entities.summary: Jeffrey Scott Chiesa is an American lawyer and politician who served as a United States senator from New Jersey from June 6 to October 30, 2013. As a member of the Republican Party, he previously served as the 59th attorney general of New Jersey from January 10, 2012, until June 6, 2013.
